content:
繼昨日推出包含安全修復的系統更新後，Apple 現已詳細公布 Safari 26.6.1 的安全性內容。以下為相關細節。

Codex 在 CVE 致謝名單中多次出現

Apple 今日更新了其「Apple security releases」網頁，詳細說明 Safari 26.6.1 的錯誤修復，該版本現已可供 macOS Sonoma 及 macOS Sequoia 用戶下載。

根據該文件所示，今次更新包含 22 個 CVE，全部與 WebKit 相關，其中兩個漏洞指「處理惡意製作的網頁內容時可能導致記憶體損壞」。

值得注意的是，與近期的安全更新一樣，OpenAI Codex Security 共出現九次，進一步突顯 AI 工具在識別 Apple 軟件安全漏洞方面日益重要的角色。

以下是 Apple 對 Safari 26.6.1 的完整安全性內容：

Safari 26.6.1 was released on August 18, 2026. WebKit Available for: macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia. Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash. Description: An out-of-bounds access issue was addressed through improved bounds checking. WebKit Bugzilla: 317632. CVE-2026-64784: Janggoon Lee of Out of Bounds, OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit. Description: The issue was addressed through improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 313452. CVE-2026-43795: wwwlk. WebKit Bugzilla: 318348. CVE-2026-65338: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit. Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption. WebKit Bugzilla: 318405. CVE-2026-65341: Henock Habte. WebKit. Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed through improved locking. WebKit Bugzilla: 321480. CVE-2026-64782: Seonwook Kim, Shubham Chaskar, lattice, Josef Korbel. WebKit. Description: The issue was addressed through improved input validation. WebKit Bugzilla: 321484. CVE-2026-64781: Thomas Guillem. WebKit. Description: The issue was addressed through improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 321517. CVE-2026-65351: Niels Hofmans. WebKit Bugzilla: 316996. CVE-2026-65340: Claudio Bozzato and Francesco Benvenuto of Cisco Talos, Josef Korbel (Citadelo). WebKit Bugzilla: 317142. CVE-2026-65337: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit Bugzilla: 317349. CVE-2026-65336: Josef Korbel. WebKit Bugzilla: 316723. CVE-2026-65335: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit Bugzilla: 317603. CVE-2026-65333: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit Bugzilla: 317450. CVE-2026-65332: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit Bugzilla: 317611. CVE-2026-65331: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit. Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash. Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed through improved memory management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316347. CVE-2026-64715: Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative. WebKit. Description: The issue was addressed through improved checks. WebKit Bugzilla: 316918. CVE-2026-64780: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit. Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed through improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316791. CVE-2026-65334: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett. WebKit. Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed through improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 317317. CVE-2026-43794: Dung Do (@_piers2) of Calif.io. WebKit. Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination. WebKit Bugzilla: 313703. CVE-2026-64787: 杉山 壮太, Shubham Chaskar. WebKit History. Impact: Visiting a maliciously crafted website may lead to the exfiltration of sensitive data. WebKit Bugzilla: 315528. CVE-2026-64778: Mohit Negi. WebKit Storage. WebKit Bugzilla: 321485. CVE-2026-64779: Shubham Chaskar, Tommy DeVoss from Braze Security Team (@thedawgyg). Additional acknowledgments. WebKit. We would like to thank Henock Habte for their assistance.
